overview.text: Today's artificial intelligence landscape features significant model releases, security discussions, and architectural advancements. Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 generated substantial discussion, alongside benchmarks showing Claude Fable 5.2 achieving high scores on Artificial Analysis. In infrastructure and deployment news, Google Gemini faced scrutiny over routing personal Drive files and emails to human annotators, while ChatGPT Enterprise became available in the AWS Marketplace to simplify enterprise procurement. On the open-source and developer tooling front, the STE80 Humanizer emerged as an agent skill to remove AI tells using Simplified Technical English methods, and baidu released baidu/ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base. Research efforts also advanced through new methods like steerable multi-objective group-relative preference optimization and agentic reasoning caching for on-CPU reasoning reuse, offering fresh capabilities for practitioners optimizing model deployment and performance.

entries.title: Show HN: STE80 Humanizer – de-AI text by writing 80% of the way to ASD-STE100
entries.summary: STE80 Humanizer: agent skill that removes AI tells and rewrites text 80% of the way to ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), the method Andrej Karpathy shared. · Python
entries.why: Removes AI tells by rewriting text toward Simplified Technical English as shared by Andrej Karpathy.

entries.title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
entries.why: Brings new model capabilities that generated massive community engagement and extensive technical discussion online.

entries.title: Claude Fable 5.2 Scores 65 on Artificial Analysis, Highest So Far
entries.why: Demonstrates benchmark performance by scoring high on Artificial Analysis compared to peers.

entries.title: Google Gemini routes personal Drive files and emails to human annotators
entries.why: Highlights critical privacy implications regarding how personal user data is handled by major providers.

entries.title: Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters
entries.summary: Language model deployment often requires different trade-offs between competing objectives as user preferences change, yet standard post-training methods typically produce a single policy for a fixed objective weighting.
entries.why: Enables better trade-offs between competing objectives during language model post-training and deployment.

entries.title: IWIBench: Evaluating Gradient-Free Model Driven Intra-weight Injection
entries.summary: Intra-weight injection lets one model change another model's behaviour by editing its weights directly, without gradients. Such edits can range from altering lexical associations to enforcing output formats or updating factual knowledge.
entries.why: Allows direct model behavior modification through gradient-free intra-weight injection.

entries.title: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
entries.summary: Large language models reinvent the wheel all the time. They conflate task-solving with the execution of the solutions, which forces them to solve every problem from scratch.
entries.why: Reuses reasoning steps on-CPU to prevent language models from repeatedly solving identical tasks from scratch.

entries.title: Locating the source of a mysterious beep with Claude
entries.summary: Our house has a box room, full of boxes that we still haven't unpacked from our last move. A couple of weeks ago something in that room started intermittently beeping.
entries.why: Showcases practical problem-solving using language models for real-world troubleshooting tasks.

entries.title: Fable 5.2 and Jagged AGI
entries.summary: General, often expert, and sometimes jagged
entries.why: Analyzes the jagged nature of general expert intelligence in modern systems.

entries.title: Where is all the AI safety research uplift?
entries.summary: (Thanks to @Goutham Nalagatla for discussion and for sitting with me and talking about it while I wrote it.) METR recently released a report estimating that Anthropic is getting an overall 1.7x acceleration in AI capability progress as a result of AI accelerating their work.
entries.why: Estimates the acceleration in capability progress driven by automated research workflows.
